item.title: Forecasting China’s Posturing for a Global War
item.description:
This collaborative study conducts a comprehensive examination of China’s global strategy as it relates to preparing for a potential war with the West, using potential futures to help shape the present. It explores a hypothetical limited conflict scenario between the United States and the People’s Republic of China, predicting China’s deliberate decisions to horizontally escalate the conflict based on historical trends. This novel approach is a unique addition to the literature on great power competition, offering detailed, tangible forecasts of China’s upcoming actions and corresponding recommendations to help mitigate the rising power’s growing global influence. The study is separated into four parts. The first part examines China’s logic and decision making to appreciate the adversary’s perspective and avoid mirror imaging. The second section establishes the scenario and includes assessments of seven distinct regions of the world. The third section shifts the assessment to the space and information domains. The final section focuses the regional and domain analysis into a global discussion, synthesizes the book’s findings, and consolidates the recommendations of the individual chapter authors in a concise, easily digestible manner.

item.title: CLSC In Translation 2: Influence of Unmanned Warfare on Political Work and Our Responses
item.description:
Editorial Note: This article was translated using a hybrid approach combining AI assistance with a thorough review by the expert human translator to ensure cultural accuracy, correct terminology, and readability while maintaining the original tone, context, and intent of the article. Read the CLSC analysis here.

"With the rapid advancement of technologies related to unmanned and intelligent systems, unmanned warfare is set to become a primary mode of modern combat. This shift will exert a profound and far-reaching impact on political work across various domains—including Party leadership over operations, human resource support, the cultivation of combat spirit, mass mobilization for front-line support, battlefield discipline and law enforcement, security and protection, and the contest for cognitive dominance. It is imperative to drive the innovative development of political work for unmanned warfare by taking comprehensive action to update mindsets, refine regulations and systems, prioritize key areas, optimize operational models, innovate methods and means, and strengthen the core workforce, thereby providing the necessary service and assurance to secure victory in unmanned combat operations."

item.title: CLSC In Translation 1: An Analysis of Political Work in Combined Arms Brigade Offensive Operations
item.description:
Editorial Note: This article was translated using a hybrid approach combining AI assistance with a thorough review by the expert human translator to ensure cultural accuracy, correct terminology, and readability  while maintaining the original tone, context, and intent of the article. Read the CLSC analysis here.

"During combined arms brigade offensive operations, political work elements play dual roles: providing service support and engaging in direct combat. It is essential to accurately grasp the missions and core content of political work elements across various stages, including combat preparation, the initiation of combat, the forward progression of combat operations, the pausing or conclusion of combat, and post-conflict stabilization. This ensures they are aligned with and integrated into joint combat operations to provide robust support for achieving victory."
